A01.evidence: Owner performed Explorer checks. Exact native/bound records show 10 of 11 multiple-drop filenames unchanged, but literal %PATH%.mov expanded. Retain A01 failed conservatively for the whole required special-character cohort; folder observation additionally pending.

A02.evidence: Actual Explorer-launched Check.bat recorder shows literal %PATH% substituted with PATH before the actual BAT starts; !NAME! arrives unchanged. Automated env-seeded passes do not supersede this failed real caller path. No payload-like names executed.

A03.evidence: Actual BAT has one direct -File %* invocation, DisableDelayedExpansion, no ARGS/CALL/-Command/Invoke-Expression/cmd pipeline/Set-ExecutionPolicy. Existing process-only Bypass retained; static parse/analyzer/encoding/tracker and targeted tests pass both hosts.

A04.evidence: Owner performed prepared Explorer checks then reported all appeared to pass on 2026-10-05. Missing PS1/FFmpeg/FFprobe/read-denied diagnostics in the kit are covered by that direct observation; owner's tentative wording retained. Seven automated errors independently pass; no real encoder validation.

limitations: Actual owner Explorer run fails A01/A02 due literal %PATH% substitution; A04 passes from owner report. Folder-specific observation is still pending. Task stays implemented and draft; no waiver/supported-path redefinition.

Outer CMD expands literal %PATH% and /V:ON may expand !NAME! before BAT starts. Quoted CMD/BAT paths ending in one backslash can arrive with a literal closing quote. These remain measured limits; no unlimited/shell-independent drop guarantee.
Windows CMD/batch expanded command lines are limited to 8191 characters; use folder drops or smaller selections.
The retained -NoExit keeps startup errors visible at a prompt. A subsequent plain exit can return zero; no new unattended startup-exit contract is claimed.
Readability checks do not validate executable format, execute ACLs, FFmpeg capabilities or codec behavior; those broader checks belong to later tasks.
Full not rerun for this bounded slice. Four existing config/enumeration defects remain explicitly NotRun in Quick/Targeted. Four media cases skip because FFmpeg/FFprobe are unavailable.
22 new Pester checks plus the existing 75 and four static gates yield Quick 101. Targeted adds six existing native entry/menu cases and eight synthetic probe JSON fixtures for 115.
Manual fixture and raw reports contain local paths/possible environment expansion; all stay outside Git. No private media, dependency binaries, configuration or raw logs committed.

Read-only subagent review fixed a report-integrity defect and clarified /V:ON test wording. One checkout writer; no automatic dependency download, main push/merge, policy change, release, deployment or settings/secrets change.
